label: Food Moment
description: The frozen action frame appetite campaigns are built on.

items.name: cheese-pull
items.text: a slow cheese pull, ropes of molten mozzarella stretching between slice and pie, strands thinning to glass threads

items.name: honey-ribbon
items.text: honey ribboning off a wooden dipper, the falling ribbon folding on itself in slow amber coils

items.name: ganache-pour
items.text: warm ganache poured over a cake, the glossy flood front advancing and curtaining down the sides

items.name: brulee-crack
items.text: a spoon breaking through crème brûlée, the amber sugar glass shattering over trembling custard

items.name: flambe-flare
items.text: a pan flambé at full flare, blue-rooted flames rolling over caramelizing fruit

items.name: sugar-dust
items.text: powdered sugar sifting down through raking light, settling on dark chocolate like first snow

items.name: yolk-break
items.text: a golden yolk broken open, slow yellow lava finding every crevice of the dish below

items.name: butter-baste
items.text: butter-basting mid-spoonful, foaming brown butter and thyme riding over a searing crust

items.name: torch-sear
items.text: a chef's torch kissing the surface, fat blistering and pearling at the exact line of the flame

items.name: steam-burst
items.text: a bao torn open, a backlit plume of steam bursting from the soft white interior

items.name: oil-drizzle
items.text: olive oil drizzled in one thin gold thread, catching the light as it pools into a green-gold coin

items.name: noodle-lift
items.text: noodles lifted high on chopsticks, broth streaming back into the bowl below, backlit steam wrapping every strand

items.name: wok-toss
items.text: a wok toss at full flame, rice and scallions airborne in one sheet, a tongue of fire climbing the rim, smoke rolling off the carbon steel

items.name: salt-pinch
items.text: a chef's pinch of flaky salt falling from height, crystals catching the light like slow confetti over the sliced crust below

items.name: sauce-nappe
items.text: sauce spooned in a slow nappe over the plated fillet, the coat thick enough to hold its edge, the excess drawing one clean line to the rim
